src.title: Sebi may propose raising FPI beneficial ownership threshold to 25%

dossier.headline: SEBI weighs raising FPI beneficial-ownership threshold to 25%
dossier.summary: SEBI may propose raising the beneficial-ownership threshold for foreign portfolio investors to 25%, Business Standard reported on Monday. The idea is at the proposal stage and comes during a strong run of foreign buying.
why_it_matters: Ownership rules shape how easily foreign funds can invest in India
Foreign investors have been heavy buyers for three straight weeks
watch: A formal consultation paper from SEBI
questions: What is the current threshold, and who would the change affect?
